information:
List of plants (common and scientific names) that are **Prohibited** in New York State, as defined in the NYS Department of Environmental Conservation “Prohibited and Regulated Invasive Plants” PDF (issued 10 Sept 2014, effective 6 months later).  
The list is divided by habitat type, followed by the common name and its scientific name.  Entries that had only a common name (no scientific match in the PDF) are noted as “–”.

> Source: https://extapps.dec.ny.gov/docs/lands_forests_pdf/isprohibitedplants2.pdf  

---

2. Amur Honeysuckle – **Lonicera maackii**  
3. Autumn Olive – **Elaeagnus umbellata**

49. Wineberry – **Rubus phoenicolasius**

### Wetland Plants

52. Marsh Dewfower – **Murdannia keisak**  
53. Purple Loosestrife – **Lythrum salicaria**  
54. Reed Manna Grass – **Glyceria maxima**  
55. Smooth Buckthorn – **Frangula alnus**  
56. Yellow Iris – **Iris pseudacorus** (Rhamnus frangula)

### Aquatic Plants  
57. Brazilian Waterweed – **Egeria densa**  
58. Broadleaf Water‑milfoil – **Myriophyllum heterophyllum × M. laxum**

60. Fanwort – **Cabomba caroliniana**  
61. Floating Primrose Willow – **Ludwigia peploides**  
62. Frogbit – **Hydrocharis morsus‑ranae**  
63. Hydrilla/Water Thyme – **Hydrilla verticillata**  
64. Parrot‑feather – **Myriophyllum aquaticum**  
65. Uruguayan Primrose Willow – **Ludwigia hexapetala** (L. grandifora)  
66. Water Chestnut – **Trapa natans**  
67. Yellow Floating Heart – **Nymphoides peltata**
